verdict.rationale: Groq ships an official TypeScript SDK (github repo groq-typescript) and documents OpenAI-compatible client usage (api_key/base_url pattern) across Python and JS examples for chat, streaming, tool use, structured outputs, batch, and audio transcription, all backed by first-party docs and a public GitHub repo. missing for 10: no explicit official Python SDK repo citation (only OpenAI-client compatibility docs) and no independent/hands-on review specifically validating SDK ergonomics.
